If it is performed with a probationer as the twentieth member... and so on... with a male novice... with a female novice... with one who has renounced the training... with one who has committed an ultimate offense... with one suspended for not seeing an offense... with one suspended for not making amends for an offense... with one suspended for not relinquishing a wrong view... with a eunuch... with one who co-resides by theft... with one who has gone over to another sect... with an animal... with a matricide... with a patricide... with a murderer of an Arahant... with a defiler of a bhikkhunī... with a creator of schism in the Saṅgha... with one who has maliciously drawn the blood of a Buddha... with one of both sexes... with one of a different communion... with one standing in a different boundary... with one standing in the air by psychic power... or if an act is performed by a Saṅgha with the person on whom the act is being performed as the twentieth member—it is not a valid act and should not be done.

Vīsativaggakaraṇaṃ.

The chapter on acts requiring a group of twenty is concluded.

Catuvaggakaraṇādikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Acts Performed by a Group of Four, and so forth, is concluded.

238. Pārivāsikādikathā

The discourse on those undergoing probation, and so on.

393. Pārivāsikacatuttho [T 2.0262] ce, bhikkhave, parivāsaṃ dadeyya, mūlāya paṭikasseyya, mānattaṃ dadeyya, taṃvīso abbheyya – akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ. Mūlāya paṭikassanārahacatuttho ce, bhikkhave, parivāsaṃ dadeyya, mūlāya paṭikasseyya, mānattaṃ dadeyya, taṃvīso abbheyya – akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ. Mānattārahacatuttho ce, bhikkhave, parivāsaṃ dadeyya, mūlāya paṭikasseyya, mānattaṃ dadeyya, taṃvīso abbheyya [P 1.0321] – akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ. Mānattacārikacatuttho ce, bhikkhave, parivāsaṃ dadeyya, mūlāya paṭikasseyya, mānattaṃ dadeyya, taṃvīso abbheyya – akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ. Abbhānārahacatuttho ce, bhikkhave, parivāsaṃ dadeyya, mūlāya paṭikasseyya, mānattaṃ dadeyya, taṃvīso abbheyya – akammaṃ na ca karaṇīyaṃ.

238. Monks, if a Saṅgha of four that includes a monk on probation should grant probation, send him back to the beginning, or grant penance, or if a Saṅgha of twenty including that same monk should rehabilitate him, it is not a valid act and should not be done. Monks, if a Saṅgha of four that includes a monk deserving to be sent back to the beginning should grant probation, send him back to the beginning, or grant penance, or if a Saṅgha of twenty including that same monk should rehabilitate him, it is not a valid act and should not be done. Monks, if a Saṅgha of four that includes a monk deserving penance should grant probation, send him back to the beginning, or grant penance, or if a Saṅgha of twenty including that same monk should rehabilitate him, it is not a valid act and should not be done. Monks, if a Saṅgha of four that includes a monk undergoing penance should grant probation, send him back to the beginning, or grant penance, or if a Saṅgha of twenty including that same monk should rehabilitate him, it is not a valid act and should not be done. Monks, if a Saṅgha of four that includes a monk deserving rehabilitation should grant probation, send him back to the beginning, or grant penance, or if a Saṅgha of twenty including that same monk should rehabilitate him, it is not a valid act and should not be done.

394. Ekaccassa, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā ruhati, ekaccassa na ruhati. Kassa ca, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā na ruhati? Bhikkhuniyā, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā na ruhati. Sikkhamānāya, bhikkhave…pe… sāmaṇerassa, bhikkhave… sāmaṇeriyā, bhikkhave… sikkhāpaccakkhātakassa bhikkhave… antimavatthuṃ ajjhāpannakassa, bhikkhave [V 0.0419] … ummattakassa, bhikkhave… khittacittassa, bhikkhave… vedanāṭṭassa, bhikkhave… āpattiyā adassane ukkhittakassa, bhikkhave… āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhittakassa, bhikkhave… pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge [T 2.0263] ukkhittakassa, bhikkhave… paṇḍakassa, bhikkhave… theyyasaṃvāsakassa, bhikkhave… titthiyapakkantakassa, bhikkhave [M 0.0443]… tiracchānagatassa bhikkhave… mātughātakassa, bhikkhave… pitughātakassa, bhikkhave… arahantaghātakassa, bhikkhave… bhikkhunidūsakassa, bhikkhave… saṅghabhedakassa, bhikkhave… lohituppādakassa, bhikkhave… ubhatobyañjanakassa, bhikkhave… nānāsaṃvāsakassa, bhikkhave… nānāsīmāya ṭhitassa, bhikkhave… iddhiyā vehāse ṭhitassa, bhikkhave, yassa saṅgho kammaṃ karoti, tassa ca tassa (syā.), bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā na ruhati. Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā na ruhati.

394. Monks, for some, a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is effective; for others, it is not. And for whom, monks, is a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha not effective? For a bhikkhunī, monks, a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is not effective. For a female trainee, monks… for a male novice… for a female novice… for one who has given up the training… for one who has committed a Pārājika offense… for an insane person… for one with a deranged mind… for one afflicted by pain… for one suspended for not seeing an offense… for one suspended for not making amends for an offense… for one suspended for not relinquishing a wrong view… for a paṇḍaka… for a theyyasaṃvāsaka… for one who has gone over to the sectarians… for an animal… for a matricide… for a patricide… for an arahant-killer… for one who has violated a bhikkhunī… for a schismatic… for one who has caused the Buddha's blood to flow… for a hermaphrodite… for one of a different communion… for one standing in a different boundary… for one standing in the air by psychic power; and for one on whom the Saṅgha is performing a formal act, a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is not effective. Indeed, for these, monks, a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is not effective.

Kassa ca, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā ruhati? Bhikkhussa, bhikkhave, pakatattassa

And for whom, monks, is a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha effective? For a monk, monks, who is in good standing,

Samānasaṃvāsakassa samānasīmāya ṭhitassa antamaso ānantarikassāpi anantarikassāpi (syā.) bhikkhuno viññāpentassa saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā ruhati. Imassa kho, bhikkhave, saṅghamajjhe paṭikkosanā ruhati.

of the same communion, standing in the same boundary; a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is effective for one who makes it known, even if only to the monk immediately beside him. For this one, monks, a protest in the midst of the Saṅgha is effective.

Pārivāsikādikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Those Undergoing Probation, and so on, is concluded.

239. Dvenissāraṇādikathā

Discourse on the Two Expulsions and so on

395. Dvemā, bhikkhave, nissāraṇā. Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ. Tañce saṅgho nissāreti, ekacco sunissārito, ekacco dunnissārito. Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho nissāreti – dunnissārito? Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu suddho hoti anāpattiko. Tañce saṅgho nissāreti – dunnissārito. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho nissāreti – dunnissārito.

239. Monks, there are these two expulsions. There is, monks, a person not liable for expulsion. If the Saṅgha expels him, in one case he is well-expelled, and in another case he is badly-expelled. And which, monks, is the person not liable for expulsion, whom, if the Saṅgha expels, is badly-expelled? Here, monks, a bhikkhu is pure and without offense. If the Saṅgha expels him, he is badly-expelled. This, monks, is called the person not liable for expulsion, whom, if the Saṅgha expels, is badly-expelled.

Katamo [T 2.0264] ca, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho nissāreti – sunissārito? Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bālo hoti abyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno, gihisaṃsaṭṭho [P 1.0322] viharati ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehi, tañce saṅgho nissāreti – sunissārito. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto nissāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho nissāreti – sunissārito.

395. And which, monks, is the person not liable for expulsion, whom, if the Saṅgha expels, is well-expelled? Here, monks, a bhikkhu is foolish, incompetent, has many offenses, and is indiscriminate in his offenses; he dwells associating with householders through unsuitable associations with householders. If the Saṅgha expels him, he is well-expelled. This, monks, is called the person not liable for expulsion, whom, if the Saṅgha expels, is well-expelled.

396. Dvemā[V 0.0420], bhikkhave, osāraṇā. Atthi, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ tañce saṅgho osāreti, ekacco sosārito, ekacco [M 0.0444] dosārito. Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – dosārito? Paṇḍako, bhikkhave, appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – dosārito. Theyyasaṃvāsako, bhikkhave, appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – dosārito. Titthiyapakkantako, bhikkhave…pe… tiracchānagato, bhikkhave… mātughātako, bhikkhave… pitughātako, bhikkhave… arahantaghātako, bhikkhave… bhikkhunidūsako, bhikkhave… saṅghabhedako, bhikkhave… lohituppādako, bhikkhave… ubhatobyañjanako, bhikkhave, appatto, osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – dosārito. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – dosārito. Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, puggalā appattā osāraṇaṃ, te ce saṅgho osāreti – dosāritā.

Monks, there are these two admissions. There is, monks, a person not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha performs an admission, one is a proper admission, and the other is an improper admission. And who, monks, is the person not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—it is an improper admission? A eunuch, monks, is not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha admits him—it is an improper admission. One who lives in communion by theft, monks, is not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha admits him—it is an improper admission. One who has gone over to another sect, monks… an animal, monks… a matricide, monks… a patricide, monks… a killer of an arahant, monks… a violator of a bhikkhunī, monks… a creator of schism in the Saṅgha, monks… one who has caused the Buddha’s blood to flow, monks… a hermaphrodite, monks, is not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha admits him—it is an improper admission. This, monks, is called the person not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—it is an improper admission. These, monks, are called persons not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—these are improper admissions.

Katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – sosārito? Hatthacchinno, bhikkhave, appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti, sosārito. Pādacchinno, bhikkhave…pe… hatthapādacchinno, bhikkhave… kaṇṇacchinno[T 2.0265], bhikkhave… nāsacchinno, bhikkhave… kaṇṇanāsacchinno, bhikkhave… aṅgulicchinno, bhikkhave… aḷacchinno, bhikkhave… kaṇḍaracchinno, bhikkhave… phaṇahatthako, bhikkhave… khujjo, bhikkhave… vāmano, bhikkhave… galagaṇḍī, bhikkhave… lakkhaṇāhato, bhikkhave… kasāhato, bhikkhave… likhitako, bhikkhave… sīpadiko, bhikkhave… pāparogī, bhikkhave… parisadūsako, bhikkhave… kāṇo, bhikkhave… kuṇī, bhikkhave… khañjo, bhikkhave… pakkhahato, bhikkhave… chinniriyāpatho, bhikkhave… jarādubbalo, bhikkhave… andho, bhikkhave… mūgo, bhikkhave… badhiro, bhikkhave… andhamūgo, bhikkhave… andhabadhiro, bhikkhave… mūgabadhiro, bhikkhave… andhamūgabadhiro, bhikkhave, appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – sosārito. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo appatto osāraṇaṃ, tañce saṅgho osāreti – sosārito. Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, puggalā appattā osāraṇaṃ, te ce saṅgho osāreti – sosāritā.

And who, bhikkhus, is the person not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—he is properly admitted? One whose hand is cut off, bhikkhus, is not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha admits him—he is properly admitted. One whose foot is cut off, bhikkhus… one whose hand and foot are cut off, bhikkhus… one whose ear is cut off, bhikkhus… one whose nose is cut off, bhikkhus… one whose ear and nose are cut off, bhikkhus… one whose fingers are cut off, bhikkhus… one whose thumb or big toe is cut off, bhikkhus… one whose tendon is cut off, bhikkhus… one who has a webbed hand, bhikkhus… one who is hunchbacked, bhikkhus… one who is a dwarf, bhikkhus… one who has a goiter, bhikkhus… one who is marked by branding, bhikkhus… one who is marked by whipping, bhikkhus… one who is a proclaimed robber, bhikkhus… one who has elephantiasis, bhikkhus… one who has a foul disease, bhikkhus… one who corrupts assemblies, bhikkhus… one who is one-eyed, bhikkhus… one who has a crooked limb, bhikkhus… one who is lame, bhikkhus… one who is paralyzed, bhikkhus… one who is a cripple, bhikkhus… one who is weak with age, bhikkhus… one who is blind, bhikkhus… one who is mute, bhikkhus… one who is deaf, bhikkhus… one who is blind and mute, bhikkhus… one who is blind and deaf, bhikkhus… one who is mute and deaf, bhikkhus… one who is blind, mute, and deaf, bhikkhus, is not eligible for admission. If the Saṅgha admits him—he is properly admitted. This, bhikkhus, is called the person not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—he is properly admitted. These, bhikkhus, are called persons not eligible for admission, whom if the Saṅgha admits—they are properly admitted.

Dvenissāraṇādikathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on the two kinds of expulsion and so forth is concluded.

Vāsabhagāmabhāṇavāro niṭṭhito paṭhamo.

The first recitation section concerning Vāsabhagāma is concluded.

240. Adhammakammādikathā

240. Discussion on Unlawful Acts and so forth

397. Idha [M 0.0445][V 0.0421] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpatti”nti? So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyya”nti. Taṃ [P 1.0323] saṅgho āpattiyā adassane ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

397. Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be seen. Yet the Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see this offense?” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should see.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-seeing of the offense—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, paṭikarohi [T 2.0266] taṃ āpatti”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamayaṃ paṭikareyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be remedied. Yet the Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; remedy that offense.” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should remedy.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-remedying of the offense—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “pāpikā te, āvuso, diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no evil view to be relinquished. Yet the Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.” He says: “I have no evil view, friends, that I should relinquish.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-relinquishment of the evil view—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, na hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpatti? Paṭikarohi taṃ āpatti”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ paṭikareyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho adassane vā appaṭikamme vā ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be seen, and no offense to be remedied. Yet the Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense? Remedy that offense.” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should see. I have no offense, friends, that I should remedy.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-seeing or non-remedying—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, na hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpattiṃ? Pāpikā te diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyyaṃ; natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho adassane vā appaṭinissagge [T 2.0267] vā ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be seen, and no evil view to be relinquished. Yet the Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense? You have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should see; I have no evil view, friends, that I should relinquish.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-seeing or non-relinquishment—an unlawful act.

Idha [M 0.0446][V 0.0422] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, na hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, paṭikarohi taṃ āpattiṃ; pāpikā te diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ paṭikareyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be remedied, and no evil view to be relinquished. The Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; remedy that offense. You have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should remedy. I have no evil view, friends, that I should relinquish.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-remedying or non-relinquishment—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa na hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, na hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, na hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā [P 1.0324] ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpattiṃ? Paṭikarohi taṃ āpattiṃ; pāpikā te diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ paṭikareyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has no offense to be seen, no offense to be remedied, and no evil view to be relinquished. The Saṅgha or a number of bhikkhus or an individual accuses him thus: “Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense? Remedy that offense. You have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.” He says: “I have no offense, friends, that I should see. I have no offense, friends, that I should remedy. I have no evil view, friends, that I should relinquish.” The Saṅgha suspends him for non-seeing, non-remedying, or non-relinquishment—an unlawful act.

398. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti. Saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ[T 2.0268], āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpatti”nti? So evaṃ vadeti – “āmāvuso, passāmī”ti. Taṃ saṅgho āpattiyā adassane ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

398. Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense to be seen. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see this offense?’ He says: ‘Yes, friends, I see it.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not seeing the offense—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, paṭikarohi taṃ āpatti”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “āmāvuso, paṭikarissāmī”ti. Taṃ saṅgho āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense that is to be remedied. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; remedy that offense.’ He says thus: ‘Yes, friends, I will remedy it.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not remedying the offense—an unlawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “pāpikā te, āvuso, diṭṭhi; paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “āmāvuso[M 0.0447], paṭinissajjissāmī”ti. Taṃ saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has a wrong view that is to be relinquished. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have a wrong view; relinquish that wrong view.’ He says thus: ‘Yes, friends, I will relinquish it.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not relinquishing the wrong view—an unlawful act.

Idha [V 0.0423] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā…pe… hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā…pe… hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā…pe… hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpattiṃ? Paṭikarohi taṃ āpattiṃ; pāpikā te diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “āmāvuso, passāmi, āma paṭikarissāmi, āma paṭinissajjissāmī”ti[T 2.0269]. Taṃ saṅgho adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhipati – adhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense that is to be seen and an offense that is to be remedied… an offense that is to be seen and a wrong view that is to be relinquished… an offense that is to be remedied and a wrong view that is to be relinquished… an offense that is to be seen, an offense that is to be remedied, and a wrong view that is to be relinquished. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense? Remedy that offense. You have a wrong view; relinquish that wrong view.’ He says thus: ‘Yes, friends, I see it; yes, I will remedy it; yes, I will relinquish it.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not seeing, or for not remedying, or for not relinquishing—an unlawful act.

399. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ āpatti”nti? So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyya”nti. Taṃ [P 1.0325] saṅgho āpattiyā adassane ukkhipati – dhammakammaṃ.

399. Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense to be seen. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense?’ He says thus: ‘Friends, I have no offense that I should see.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not seeing the offense—a lawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, paṭikarohi taṃ āpatti”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ paṭikareyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhipati – dhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense to be remedied. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; remedy that offense.’ He says thus: ‘Friends, I have no offense that I should remedy.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not remedying the offense—a lawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “pāpikā te, āvuso, diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhipati – dhammakammaṃ.

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an evil view to be relinquished. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.’ He says thus: ‘Friends, I have no evil view that I should relinquish.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not relinquishing the evil view—a lawful act.

Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhussa hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā…pe…

Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu has an offense to be seen and an offense to be remedied…

Hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā…pe… hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi paṭinissajjetā [M 0.0448]…pe… hoti āpatti daṭṭhabbā, hoti āpatti paṭikātabbā, hoti pāpikā diṭṭhi [T 2.0270] paṭinissajjetā. Tamenaṃ codeti saṅgho vā sambahulā vā ekapuggalo vā – “āpattiṃ tvaṃ, āvuso, āpanno, passasetaṃ [V 0.0424] āpattiṃ? Paṭikarohi taṃ āpattiṃ. Pāpikā te diṭṭhi, paṭinissajjetaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhi”nti. So evaṃ vadeti – “natthi me, āvuso, āpatti, yamahaṃ passeyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, āpatti yamahaṃ paṭikareyyaṃ. Natthi me, āvuso, pāpikā diṭṭhi, yamahaṃ paṭinissajjeyya”nti. Taṃ saṅgho adassane vā appaṭikamme vā appaṭinissagge vā ukkhipati – dhammakammanti.

He has an offense to be seen and an evil view to be relinquished… he has an offense to be remedied and an evil view to be relinquished… he has an offense to be seen, an offense to be remedied, and an evil view to be relinquished. The Saṅgha, or a number of bhikkhus, or an individual accuses him thus: ‘Friend, you have committed an offense; do you see that offense? Remedy that offense. You have an evil view; relinquish that evil view.’ He says thus: ‘Friends, I have no offense that I should see. Friends, I have no offense that I should remedy. Friends, I have no evil view that I should relinquish.’ The Saṅgha suspends him for not seeing, or for not remedying, or for not relinquishing—a lawful act.

Adhammakammādikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Unlawful Acts, and so forth, is concluded.

241. Upālipucchākathā

241. The Discourse on the Questions of Upāli

400. Atha kho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – “yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho sammukhākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ asammukhā karoti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Adhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, avinayakamma”nti. “Yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho paṭipucchākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ appaṭipucchā karoti…pe… paṭiññāyakaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ apaṭiññāya karoti… sativinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti [T 2.0271]… niyassakammārahassa [P 1.0326] pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… parivāsārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa mānattaṃ deti… mānattārahaṃ abbheti… abbhānārahaṃ upasampādeti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Adhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, avinayakammaṃ”.

400. Then the Venerable Upāli approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the Venerable Upāli said to the Blessed One: “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done in the presence, but does so in absence, is that a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma, Venerable sir, a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That is a formal act not in accordance with the Dhamma, Upāli, a formal act not in accordance with the Vinaya.” “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done after questioning, but does so without questioning… and so on… performs a formal act that should be done after acknowledgment, but does so without acknowledgment… gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness… performs the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā on one deserving the verdict of past insanity… performs the formal act of censure on one deserving the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā… performs the formal act of subordination on one deserving the formal act of censure… performs the formal act of banishment on one deserving the formal act of subordination… performs the formal act of reconciliation on one deserving the formal act of banishment… performs the formal act of suspension on one deserving the formal act of reconciliation… gives probation to one deserving the formal act of suspension… sends one deserving probation back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning… rehabilitates one deserving penance… gives higher ordination to one deserving rehabilitation—is that a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma, Venerable sir, a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That is a formal act not in accordance with the Dhamma, Upāli, and a formal act not in accordance with the Vinaya.”

“Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho sammukhākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ asammukhā karoti, evaṃ kho, upāli, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ, evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti. Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho paṭipucchākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ appaṭipucchā karoti…pe… paṭiññāyakaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ [M 0.0449] apaṭiññāya karoti… sativinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… niyassakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa [V 0.0425] ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… parivāsārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa mānattaṃ deti… mānattārahaṃ abbheti… abbhānārahaṃ upasampādeti, evaṃ kho, upāli, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hotī”ti.

“Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done in the presence, but does so in absence, in this way, Upāli, it is a formal act not in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act not in accordance with the Vinaya, and the Saṅgha is thereby at fault. Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done after questioning, but does so without questioning… and so on… performs a formal act that should be done after acknowledgment, but does so without acknowledgment… gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness… performs the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā on one deserving the verdict of past insanity… performs the formal act of censure on one deserving the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā… performs the formal act of subordination on one deserving the formal act of censure… performs the formal act of banishment on one deserving the formal act of subordination… performs the formal act of reconciliation on one deserving the formal act of banishment… performs the formal act of suspension on one deserving the formal act of reconciliation… gives probation to one deserving the formal act of suspension… sends one deserving probation back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning… rehabilitates one deserving penance… gives higher ordination to one deserving rehabilitation, in this way, Upāli, it is a formal act not in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act not in accordance with the Vinaya, and the Saṅgha is thereby at fault.”

401. “Yo [T 2.0272] nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho sammukhākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ sammukhā karoti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Dhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, vinayakamma”nti. “Yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho paṭipucchākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ paṭipucchā karoti…pe… paṭiññāyakaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ paṭiññāya karoti… sativinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… niyassakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… parivāsārahassa parivāsaṃ deti mūlāyapaṭikassanārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… mānattārahassa mānattaṃ deti… abbhānārahaṃ abbheti… upasampadārahaṃ upasampādeti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Dhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, vinayakammaṃ.

401. “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done in the presence, and does so in the presence, is that a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma, Venerable sir, a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya.” “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done after questioning, and does so after questioning… and so on… performs a formal act that should be done with acknowledgement, and does so with acknowledgement… gives the verdict of mindfulness to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness… gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of past insanity… performs the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā on one deserving the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā… performs the formal act of censure on one deserving the formal act of censure… performs the formal act of subordination on one deserving the formal act of subordination… performs the formal act of banishment on one deserving the formal act of banishment… performs the formal act of reconciliation on one deserving the formal act of reconciliation… performs the formal act of suspension on one deserving the formal act of suspension… gives probation to one deserving probation… sends back to the beginning one who is deserving of being sent back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving penance… rehabilitates one deserving rehabilitation… gives higher ordination to one deserving higher ordination—is that a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma, Venerable sir, a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya.”

“Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho sammukhākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ sammukhā karoti, evaṃ kho, upāli, dhammakammaṃ hoti vinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho anatisāro hoti. Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho paṭipucchākaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ paṭipucchā karoti… paṭiññāyakaraṇīyaṃ kammaṃ paṭiññāya karoti… sativinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa [T 2.0273] tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… niyassakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti [M 0.0450]… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… parivāsārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… mānattārahassa mānattaṃ deti… abbhānārahaṃ abbheti… upasampadārahaṃ upasampādeti, evaṃ kho, upāli, dhammakammaṃ hoti vinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho anatisāro hotī”ti.

“Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done in the presence, and does so in the presence, in this way, Upāli, it is a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya, and the Saṅgha is thereby without transgression. Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha performs a formal act that should be done after questioning, and does so after questioning… and so on… performs a formal act that should be done with acknowledgement, and does so with acknowledgement… gives the verdict of mindfulness to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness… gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of past insanity… performs the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā on one deserving the formal act of tassapāpiyasikā… performs the formal act of censure on one deserving the formal act of censure… performs the formal act of subordination on one deserving the formal act of subordination… performs the formal act of banishment on one deserving the formal act of banishment… performs the formal act of reconciliation on one deserving the formal act of reconciliation… performs the formal act of suspension on one deserving the formal act of suspension… gives probation to one deserving probation… sends back to the beginning one who is deserving of being sent back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving penance… rehabilitates one deserving rehabilitation… gives higher ordination to one deserving higher ordination—in this way, Upāli, it is a formal act in accordance with the Dhamma and a formal act in accordance with the Vinaya, and the Saṅgha is thereby without transgression.”

402. “Yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti, amūḷhavinayārahassa [V 0.0426] sativinayaṃ deti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Adhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, avinayakamma”nti. “Yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti, tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti…pe… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ [P 1.0327] karoti, tajjanīyakammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti, niyassakammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… niyassakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti, pabbājanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti, paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti, ukkhepanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa parivāsaṃ deti, parivāsārahassa [T 2.0274] ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… parivāsārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati, mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa mānattaṃ deti, mānattārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… mānattārahaṃ abbheti, abbhānārahassa mānattaṃ deti… abbhānārahaṃ upasampādeti, upasampadārahaṃ abbheti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Adhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, avinayakamma”nti.

402. “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness, or gives the verdict of mindfulness to one deserving the verdict of past insanity, is that act, Venerable sir, an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is an act not in accordance with the Dhamma, an act not in accordance with the Vinaya.” “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs the act of further punishment on one deserving the verdict of past insanity, or gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the act of further punishment… performs the act of rebuke on one deserving the act of further punishment, or performs the act of further punishment on one deserving the act of rebuke… performs the act of subordination on one deserving the act of rebuke, or performs the act of rebuke on one deserving the act of subordination… performs the act of banishment on one deserving the act of subordination, or performs the act of subordination on one deserving the act of banishment… performs the act of reconciliation on one deserving the act of banishment, or performs the act of banishment on one deserving the act of reconciliation… performs the act of suspension on one deserving the act of reconciliation, or performs the act of reconciliation on one deserving the act of suspension… gives probation to one deserving the act of suspension, or performs the act of suspension on one deserving probation… sends back to the beginning one deserving probation, or gives probation to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning, or sends back to the beginning one deserving penance… rehabilitates one deserving penance, or gives penance to one deserving rehabilitation… gives higher ordination to one deserving rehabilitation, or rehabilitates one deserving higher ordination, is that act, Venerable sir, an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is an act not in accordance with the Dhamma, an act not in accordance with the Vinaya.”

“Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti, amūḷhavinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti, evaṃ kho, upāli, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti. Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti, tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti…pe… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti, tajjanīyakammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… tajjanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti[M 0.0451], niyassakammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… niyassakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti, pabbājanīyakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… pabbājanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti, paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti, ukkhepanīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa parivāsaṃ deti, parivāsārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… parivāsārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati, mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa parivāsaṃ [T 2.0275] deti… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa mānattaṃ deti, mānattārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati – mānattārahaṃ abbheti, abbhānārahassa mānattaṃ deti… abbhānārahaṃ upasampādeti, upasampadārahaṃ abbheti, evaṃ kho, upāli, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hotī”ti.

“Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the verdict of mindfulness, or gives the verdict of mindfulness to one deserving the verdict of past insanity, this, Upāli, is an act not in accordance with the Dhamma, an act not in accordance with the Vinaya. And thus the Saṅgha is blameworthy. Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha performs the act of further punishment on one deserving the verdict of past insanity, or gives the verdict of past insanity to one deserving the act of further punishment… performs the act of rebuke on one deserving the act of further punishment, or performs the act of further punishment on one deserving the act of rebuke… performs the act of subordination on one deserving the act of rebuke, or performs the act of rebuke on one deserving the act of subordination… performs the act of banishment on one deserving the act of subordination, or performs the act of subordination on one deserving the act of banishment… performs the act of reconciliation on one deserving the act of banishment, or performs the act of banishment on one deserving the act of reconciliation… performs the act of suspension on one deserving the act of reconciliation, or performs the act of reconciliation on one deserving the act of suspension… gives probation to one deserving the act of suspension, or performs the act of suspension on one deserving probation… sends back to the beginning one deserving probation, or gives probation to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving to be sent back to the beginning, or sends back to the beginning one deserving penance… rehabilitates one deserving penance, or gives penance to one deserving rehabilitation… gives higher ordination to one deserving rehabilitation, or rehabilitates one deserving higher ordination—this, Upāli, is an act not in accordance with the Dhamma, an act not in accordance with the Vinaya. And thus the Saṅgha is blameworthy.”

403. “Yo [V 0.0427] nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti, amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Dhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, vinayakamma”nti. “Yo nu kho, bhante, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti…pe… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti…pe… tajjanīyakammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… niyassakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti…pe… pabbājanīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… parivāsārahassa parivāsaṃ deti…pe… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati…pe… mānattārahassa mānattaṃ deti…pe… abbhānārahaṃ abbheti, upasampadārahaṃ upasampādeti, dhammakammaṃ nu kho taṃ, bhante, vinayakamma”nti? “Dhammakammaṃ taṃ, upāli, vinayakammaṃ”.

403. “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha gives a verdict of mindfulness to one deserving a verdict of mindfulness, and gives a verdict of past insanity to one deserving a verdict of past insanity, is that act, Venerable sir, an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya.” “Venerable sir, if a harmonious Saṅgha gives a verdict of past insanity to one deserving a verdict of past insanity… performs the act of further punishment on one deserving the act of further punishment… performs the act of rebuke on one deserving the act of rebuke… performs the act of subordination on one deserving the act of subordination… performs the act of banishment on one deserving the act of banishment… performs the act of reconciliation on one deserving the act of reconciliation… performs the act of suspension on one deserving the act of suspension… gives probation to one deserving probation… sends back to the beginning one deserving to be sent back to the beginning… gives penance to one deserving penance… rehabilitates one deserving rehabilitation, and gives higher ordination to one deserving higher ordination, is that act, Venerable sir, an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya?” “That, Upāli, is an act in accordance with the Dhamma, an act in accordance with the Vinaya.”

“Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti, amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti, evaṃ kho, upāli, dhammakammaṃ hoti vinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho anatisāro hoti[T 2.0276]. Yo kho, upāli, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti [P 1.0328]…pe… tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti…pe… tajjanīyakammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… niyassakammārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti…pe… pabbājanīyakammārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa [M 0.0452] paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… parivāsārahassa parivāsaṃ deti…pe… mūlāya paṭikassanārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati…pe… mānattārahassa mānattaṃ deti…pe… abbhānārahaṃ abbheti, upasampadārahaṃ upasampādeti, evaṃ kho, upāli, dhammakammaṃ hoti vinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho anatisāro hotī”ti.

Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha gives a verdict of mindfulness to one worthy of a verdict of mindfulness, and gives a verdict of past insanity to one worthy of a verdict of past insanity, in this way, Upāli, it is a legal act and a disciplinary act. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameless. Upāli, when a harmonious Saṅgha gives a verdict of past insanity to one worthy of a verdict of past insanity ... performs an act of further wrongdoing for one worthy of an act of further wrongdoing ... performs an act of censure for one worthy of an act of censure ... performs an act of subordination for one worthy of an act of subordination ... performs an act of banishment for one worthy of an act of banishment ... performs an act of reconciliation for one worthy of an act of reconciliation ... performs an act of suspension for one worthy of an act of suspension ... gives probation to one worthy of probation ... sends back to the beginning one worthy of being sent back to the beginning ... gives penance to one worthy of penance ... rehabilitates one worthy of rehabilitation, and confers higher ordination on one worthy of higher ordination—in this way, Upāli, it is a legal act and a disciplinary act. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameless.

404. Atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – yo kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti. Yo kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho sativinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti…pe… sativinayārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… sativinayārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… sativinayārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… sativinayārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… sativinayārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti [V 0.0428] … sativinayārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… sativinayārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… sativinayārahassa mānattaṃ deti… sativinayārahaṃ abbheti… sativinayārahaṃ upasampādeti, evaṃ kho[T 2.0277], bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti.

404. Then the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus: “Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha gives the procedure for past insanity to one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness, this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy. Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs the act for further wrongdoing on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… performs the act of censure on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… performs the act of subordination on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… performs the act of banishment on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… performs the act of reconciliation on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… performs the act of suspension on one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… gives probation to one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… sends back to the beginning one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… gives penance to one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… rehabilitates one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness… or gives higher ordination to one worthy of the procedure based on mindfulness—this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy.”

405. Yo kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti. Yo kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho amūḷhavinayārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… amūḷhavinayārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… amūḷhavinayārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… amūḷhavinayārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… amūḷhavinayārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… amūḷhavinayārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… amūḷhavinayārahassa mānattaṃ deti… amūḷhavinayārahaṃ abbheti… amūḷhavinayārahaṃ upasampādeti… amūḷhavinayārahassa sativinayaṃ deti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti.

405. “Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs the act for further wrongdoing on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity, this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy. Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs the act of censure on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… performs the act of subordination on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… performs the act of banishment on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… performs the act of reconciliation on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… performs the act of suspension on one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… gives probation to one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… sends back to the beginning one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… gives penance to one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… rehabilitates one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… gives higher ordination to one worthy of the procedure for past insanity… or gives the procedure based on mindfulness to one worthy of the procedure for past insanity—this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy.”

406. Yo [M 0.0453] kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho tassapāpiyasikākammārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti…pe… tajjanīyakammārahassa… niyassakammārahassa… pabbājanīyakammārahassa… paṭisāraṇīyakammārahassa… ukkhepanīyakammārahassa… parivāsārahaṃ… mūlāyapaṭikassanārahassa… mānattārahaṃ… abbhānārahaṃ… upasampadārahassa sativinayaṃ deti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho sātisāro hoti. Yo kho, bhikkhave, samaggo saṅgho upasampadārahassa amūḷhavinayaṃ deti…pe… upasampadārahassa tassapāpiyasikākammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa niyassakammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karoti… upasampadārahassa parivāsaṃ deti… upasampadārahaṃ mūlāya paṭikassati… upasampadārahassa mānattaṃ deti… upasampadārahaṃ abbheti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, adhammakammaṃ hoti avinayakammaṃ. Evañca pana saṅgho [T 2.0278] sātisāro hotīti.

406. “Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha performs an act of censure on one worthy of an act for further wrongdoing… and so on for each case, down to… giving the procedure based on mindfulness to one worthy of higher ordination—this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy. Monks, if a harmonious Saṅgha gives the procedure for past insanity to one worthy of higher ordination… performs the act for further wrongdoing on one worthy of higher ordination… performs the act of censure… performs the act of subordination… performs the act of banishment… performs the act of reconciliation… performs the act of suspension… gives probation… sends one back to the beginning… gives penance… or rehabilitates one worthy of higher ordination—this, monks, is an unlawful act and an act not in accordance with the discipline. And in this way, the Saṅgha is blameworthy.”

Upālipucchākathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Upāli’s Questions is concluded.

Upālipucchābhāṇavāro niṭṭhito dutiyo.

The second recitation section on Upāli’s Questions is concluded.

242. Tajjanīyakammakathā

242. The Discourse on the Act of Censure

407. Idha [V 0.0429] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati[T 2.0279]. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ [P 1.0329] karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammena vaggā. So [M 0.0454] tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena samaggā.

407. Furthermore, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and one who creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. If it occurs to the bhikkhus in that residence thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and one who creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu unlawfully, by a divided group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha unlawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu unlawfully, by a united group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha unlawfully, by a united group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu lawfully, by a divided group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha lawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group.

408. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti [T 2.0280] – adhammena samaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato [V 0.0430] dhammapatirūpakena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā’ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā.

408. Furthermore, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and one who creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. If it occurs to the bhikkhus in that residence thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and one who creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu unlawfully, by a united group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha unlawfully, by a united group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu lawfully, by a divided group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha lawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group. That bhikkhu goes from that residence also to another residence. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus thus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has been subjected to the act of censure by the Saṅgha with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu unlawfully, by a divided group.

409. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako [M 0.0455] kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Handassa [T 2.0281] mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā.

409. Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. If it occurs to the bhikkhus there: “Friends, this bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. Come, let us perform the act of censure upon him.” They perform the act of censure upon him—lawfully, as a divided group. He then leaves that residence and goes to another. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—lawfully, by a divided group. Come, let us perform the act of censure upon him.” They perform the act of censure upon him—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a divided group. He also leaves that residence and goes to another. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. Come, let us perform the act of censure upon him.” They perform the act of censure upon him—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a united group. He also leaves that residence and goes to another. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group. Come, let us perform the act of censure upon him.” They perform the act of censure upon him—unlawfully, as a divided group. He also leaves that residence and goes to another. There too, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—unlawfully, by a divided group. Come, let us perform the act of censure upon him.” They perform the act of censure upon him—unlawfully, as a united group.

410. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako [T 2.0282] vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena [V 0.0431] samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ [M 0.0456] evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammena vaggā.

410. Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. If it occurs to the bhikkhus in that residence: “Friends, this bhikkhu is quarrelsome, contentious, disputatious, given to bickering, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a divided group. He goes from that residence to another residence. There also, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a united group. He also goes from that residence to another residence. There also, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—with a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu—unlawfully, as a divided group. He also goes from that residence to another residence. There also, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—unlawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu—unlawfully, as a united group. He also goes from that residence to another residence. There also, it occurs to the bhikkhus: “Friends, this bhikkhu has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha—unlawfully, by a united group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon this bhikkhu.” They perform the act of censure upon that bhikkhu—lawfully, as a divided group.

411. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ [T 2.0283] evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bhaṇḍanakārako kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṅghe adhikaraṇakārako. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa [P 1.0330] tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena samaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammapatirūpakena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato adhammena samaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammena vaggā. So tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena tajjanīyakammakato dhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ tajjanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa tajjanīyakammaṃ karonti – dhammapatirūpakena vaggā.

411. Furthermore, monks, a monk is quarrelsome, contentious, argumentative, given to disputes, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. If it occurs to the monks there: ‘Venerable sirs, this monk is quarrelsome, contentious, argumentative, given to disputes, and creates legal issues in the Saṅgha. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon him.’ They perform the act of censure upon him—being united, by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma. He goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the monks: ‘Venerable sirs, this monk has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by those who were united. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon him.’ They perform the act of censure upon him—being a divided group, unrighteously. He goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the monks: ‘Venerable sirs, this monk has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha unrighteously, by those who were a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon him.’ They perform the act of censure upon him—being united, unrighteously. He goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the monks: ‘Venerable sirs, this monk has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha unrighteously, by those who were united. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon him.’ They perform the act of censure upon him—being a divided group, righteously. He goes from that residence to another residence. There too, it occurs to the monks: ‘Venerable sirs, this monk has had the act of censure performed upon him by the Saṅgha righteously, by those who were a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of censure upon him.’ They perform the act of censure upon him—being a divided group, by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma.

Tajjanīyakammakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Act of Censure is concluded.

243. Niyassakammakathā

The Discourse on the Act of Subordination

412. Idha [V 0.0432] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bālo hoti abyatto āpattibahulo [T 2.0284] anapadāno, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehi[M 0.0457]. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu bālo abyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno, gihisaṃsaṭṭho viharati ananulomikehi gihisaṃsaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ niyassakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa niyassakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena niyassakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ niyassakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa niyassakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā…pe… dhammena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena samaggā…pe….

243. Furthermore, monks, in this Dispensation, a monk is ignorant, unskilled, has many offenses without limit, and dwells associated with householders in ways unsuitable for monks. If it occurs to the monks: 'Friends, this monk is indeed ignorant, unskilled, has many offenses without limit, and dwells associated with householders in ways unsuitable for monks. Come now, let us perform the act of subordination upon him.' They perform the act of subordination upon him unlawfully, as a divided group. He goes from that monastery to another monastery. There also, it occurs to the monks: 'Friends, this monk has had the act of subordination performed upon him by the Saṅgha unlawfully, as a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of subordination upon him.' They perform the act of subordination upon him unlawfully, as a united group… lawfully, as a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a united group…

Yathā heṭṭhā, tathā cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ.

412. The cycle should be completed as above.

Niyassakammakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Account of the Act of Dependence is concluded.

244. Pabbājanīyakammakathā

The Account of the Act of Banishment

413. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kuladūsako hoti pāpasamācāro. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu kuladūsako pāpasamācāro. Handassa mayaṃ pabbājanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ pabbājanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa pabbājanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā…pe… dhammena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena samaggā…pe….

Furthermore, monks, in this Dispensation, a monk is a corrupter of families and has evil conduct. If it occurs to the monks: 'Friends, this monk is indeed a corrupter of families and has evil conduct. Come now, let us perform the act of banishment upon him.' They perform the act of banishment upon him unlawfully, as a divided group. He goes from that monastery to another monastery. There also, it occurs to the monks: 'Friends, this monk has had the act of banishment performed upon him by the Saṅgha unlawfully, as a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of banishment upon him.' They perform the act of banishment upon him unlawfully, as a united group… lawfully, as a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, as a united group…

Cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ[T 2.0285].

244. The cycle should be completed.

Pabbājanīyakammakatā niṭṭhitā.

The Account of the Act of Banishment is concluded.

245. Paṭisāraṇīyakammakathā

413. The Account of the Act of Reconciliation

414. Idha [V 0.0433] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gihī akkosati paribhāsati. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu gihī akkosati paribhāsati. Handassa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena paṭisāraṇīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ [M 0.0458] karomā”ti. Te tassa paṭisāraṇīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā…pe… dhammena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena samaggā…pe….

In this Dispensation, monks, a monk insults and reviles householders. If the monks there think: “Friends, this monk insults and reviles householders. Come now, let us perform the act of reconciliation against this monk.” They perform the act of reconciliation against that monk—unlawfully, by a divided group. That monk goes from that monastery to another monastery. There too the monks think: “Friends, this monk has had an act of reconciliation performed against him by the Saṅgha, unlawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of reconciliation against this monk.” They perform the act of reconciliation against that monk—unlawfully, by a united group… lawfully, by a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a divided group… by what is a counterfeit of the Dhamma, by a united group…

Cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ.

The cycle should be completed.

Paṭisāraṇīyakammakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Account of the Act of Reconciliation is concluded.

246. Adassane ukkhepanīyakammakathā

245. The Account of the Act of Suspension for Not Seeing an Offense

415. Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passituṃ. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passituṃ. Handassa mayaṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa āpattiyā adassane ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā…pe… dhammena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena [T 2.0286] vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena samaggā…pe….

415. In this Dispensation, monks, a monk, having committed an offense, does not wish to see the offense. If the monks there think: “Friends, this monk, having committed an offense, does not wish to see the offense. Come now, let us perform the act of suspension against this monk for not seeing the offense.” They perform the act of suspension against that monk for not seeing the offense—unlawfully, by a divided group. That monk goes from that monastery to another monastery. There too the monks think: “Friends, this monk has had an act of suspension for not seeing an offense performed against him by the Saṅgha, unlawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of suspension against this monk for not seeing the offense.” They perform the act of suspension against that monk for not seeing the offense—unlawfully, by a united group… lawfully, by a divided group… by a semblance of the Dhamma, by a divided group… by a semblance of the Dhamma, by a united group….

Cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ.

The wheel is to be turned.

Adassane ukkhepanīyakammakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Account of the Act of Suspension for Not Seeing an Offense is concluded.

247. Appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammakathā

Discussion on the Act of Suspension for Not Making Amends

416. Idha [V 0.0434] pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ paṭikātuṃ. Tatra ce bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ paṭikātuṃ. Handassa mayaṃ āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti[P 1.0331]. Te tassa āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena vaggā. So tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ gacchati. Tatthapi bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti – “ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saṅghena āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammakato adhammena vaggehi. Handassa mayaṃ āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karomā”ti. Te tassa āpattiyā appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammaṃ karonti – adhammena samaggā…pe… dhammena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena vaggā… dhammapatirūpakena samaggā…pe….

247. In this Dispensation, monks, a monk, having committed an offense, does not wish to make amends for the offense. If the monks there think: “Friends, this monk, having committed an offense, does not wish to make amends for the offense. Come now, let us perform the act of suspension against this monk for not making amends for an offense.” They perform the act of suspension against that monk for not making amends for an offense—unlawfully, by a divided group. That monk goes from that monastery to another monastery. There too the monks think: “Friends, this monk has had the act of suspension for not making amends for an offense performed against him by the Saṅgha, unlawfully, by a divided group. Come now, let us perform the act of suspension against this monk for not making amends for an offense.” They perform the act of suspension against that monk for not making amends for an offense—unlawfully, by a united group… lawfully, by a divided group… by a semblance of the Dhamma, by a divided group… by a semblance of the Dhamma, by a united group….

Cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ.

416. The wheel is to be turned.

Appaṭikamme ukkhepanīyakammakathā niṭṭhitā.
